purpose: Bounded follow-up to the failed quiet-speech trial; no detector changes
selectionPolicy: Two candidates fixed before examining the 18 diagnostic frames; no additional threshold sweep. Existing corpus is development/regression, not fresh held-out evidence.
acceptance: Keep gate-trial.json primary limits unchanged. Check gate and actual PitchContour outputs separately, report per-speaker/clip losses, and audit plotted points. Fresh speaker confirmation and physical phones are required before enabling by default.
unknownTruth: AVID EGG anchors establish pitch only where confident; unknown frames never become unvoiced truth. Private recordings are listening/visual regressions, not complete pitch references.
